title: The Passive with Ser: Tenses and Agreement
goal: Use the passive with ser in the past, the present perfect and the future, and make the participle agree.
grammar: the passive with ser in several tenses, participle agreement

items: I can use the passive with *ser* in the preterite, the present perfect and the future.
I can make the participle agree with the thing that is affected.
I can tell when the passive with *ser* sounds natural and when an active verb or *se* is better.
